subject: Quasar performance readout & token capacity handshake
messages:
From: Ida Novak <ida@quasar.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Planning: Quasar performance readout & token capacity handshake

Hi Dylan / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this month — Quasar's infra team wants to run a short technical readout to align on sustained token throughput and a handoff for the load tests we'll run next week. High-level ask: validate sustained 75k tok/s for 45m, support 150k tok/s bursts, and confirm 95th percentile tail latency goals under our mix.

Proposed objectives:
- Walk the inferred request mix and KV-cache expectations
- Agree on token limits, batch sizing, and cache warm strategies
- Confirm monitoring signals and rollback triggers for the stress window
- Assign owners for pre-test checklist (credentials, ACLs, Canary datasets)

Can you confirm availability for a 60-minute technical session on either: 24 Mar 10:00-11:00 PT or 24 Mar 16:00-17:00 PT? I attached the preliminary load plan (prelim-loadplan.xlsx) and a short token matrix.

Attendees from our side: Ida Novak (Eng lead), Samir Rao (SRE), Hana Li (Perf). Please loop in whoever owns KV cache and batching.

Thanks,
Ida
Ida Novak
Engineering Manager, Quasar AI
ida@quasar.ai

--- Attachment: prelim-loadplan.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Ida Novak <ida@quasar.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Planning: Quasar performance readout & token capacity handshake

Thanks Ida — appreciate the clear objectives. We're happy to run the readout and lock the handoff for the load window. Quick notes / asks before we pick a slot:

- I'll bring Karthik (Serving Runtime) and Marissa (AE) to cover rollout and success criteria. Karthik: can you own the KV-cache strategy discussion?
- We prefer the 24 Mar 16:00-17:00 PT slot to avoid overlap with other zone tests.
- Proposed agenda (60m): 10m intros + goals, 25m architecture/deep-dive (batching/KV/cache/quantization surface), 15m runbook & monitoring hooks, 10m next steps/owners.

I'll attach a short PDF with the token matrix we use internally for target mapping (quasar-token-matrix.pdf). Also: can you share the test dataset sizes and whether you'll be sending long-context (>4096) workloads? That impacts kernel selection.

If the 16:00 PT slot is OK we'll send a calendar invite and a shared drive doc with the checklist and test persona payloads.

Best,
Dylan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0199

--- Attachment: quasar-token-matrix.pdf (document)
